title.zh: 修好 uplifting trance 的刺耳感
title.en: Uplifting trance's lead and chords are no longer harsh

highlights.zh: GS-1 的 supersaw 用错滤波模型（压到 3.2 kHz）：过零率是原生 6.6 倍、6 kHz 以上能量 8 倍，就是刺耳来源。
highlights.en: GS-1's supersaw used the wrong filter model (closed to 3.2 kHz): 6.6x the native zero-crossing rate and 8x its above-6-kHz energy — the source of the harshness.

highlights.zh: 改用原生 Supersaw 的滤波形状后：过零率 10.7k→2.6 kHz，高频占比 0.175→0.018（原生 0.022），和弦轨由偏亮变为略暗。
highlights.en: With the native Supersaw's shape: zero-crossing 10.7k to 2.6 kHz, above-6-kHz share 0.175 to 0.018 (native 0.022), chords from brighter to slightly darker.

highlights.zh: 手机版打开调试后，播放器等页面也会显示诊断窗口。
highlights.en: With debug on, mobile shows the diagnostics panel on the player and other screens too.
